title: Positivity of the edge count when an edge exists
statement: Let $G$ be a multigraph on a vertex type $\alpha$, and suppose $e$ is an edge of $G$. Then the edge count of $G$, the number of edges counted with multiplicity, is strictly positive.
hypotheses_covered: e is an edge of G (e belongs to the edge multiset of G)
replaced: If $e$ is an edge of a multigraph $G$, then $G$ has positive edge count.
